description: For an ordinal \(\alpha\ge\omega\), define \(h(\alpha)=0\), \(h(n)=n+1\) for \(n<\omega\), and \(h(\beta)=\beta\) for \(\omega\le\beta<\alpha\). Then \(h\) is a bijection from \(\alpha+1\) onto \(\alpha\).
